arguments.query: select sql from sqlite_master where type="table"

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents a,b.client_reference cr,(select group_concat(state||":"||idempotency_key||":"||amount_cents) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b
select event_id,status,attempts,substr(payload,1,150) p from outbox where status<>"delivered"

select booking_id,flight_id,client_reference cr,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch, (select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b where status="pending"
select status,count(*) n,group_concat(case when status<>"delivered" then event_id end) e from outbox group by status

select b.booking_id,b.status,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k from bookings b where b.status<>"confirmed" or k=0

select b.booking_id,b.status,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k,(select count(*) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id and status="delivered") o,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b where k=0 or o=0 or h=0

select (select group_concat(flight_id||":"||price_cents||":"||version) from flights) f,(select group_concat(key||"="||value) from cache) c,(select group_concat(status||" "||substr(message,1,60)) from (select status,message from request_logs where service="booking" order by id desc limit 6)) l

select (select group_concat(request_id||":"||kind) from customer_events) ce,(select group_concat(booking_id||":"||status) from bookings where status<>"confirmed") nb,(select count(*) from outbox where status="pending") op,(select group_concat(status||" "||substr(message,1,50)," | ") from (select status,message from request_logs where service="booking" order by id desc limit 8)) l
